gaps.lead: He jogged every morning when he was younger.
gaps.sentence: He ___ every morning when he was younger.
gaps.explanation: 'Used to + infinitive' describes a past habit.

gaps.lead: Somebody is repairing our roof at the moment.
gaps.explanation: Somebody else is doing it for us: we are having our roof repaired.

gaps.lead: He didn't study, so he failed the exam.
gaps.sentence: If he had studied, he ___ the exam.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

gaps.lead: The party was incredibly boring, so we left early.
gaps.sentence: The party was ___ we left early.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: Visitors may not feed the animals.
